title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Explore the streets and corridors immediately surrounding Beloit College, from the historic residential blocks to the revitalized downtown business district.

cards.title: State Street
cards.subtitle: Downtown Business District
cards.notes: Walk down this central corridor to find student favorites like Lucy's #7 Burger Bar and various local boutiques just blocks from the campus edge.
cards.short_summary: A primary downtown commercial street featuring popular student dining and retail options.
cards.evidence_claim: State Street is home to Pizazz and Always & Forever Formal Wear, and is a central part of the downtown area frequented by students.
cards.access_notes: Public street accessible 24/7; business hours vary.

cards.title: Grand Avenue
cards.subtitle: Riverfront Commercial Corridor
cards.notes: Cross the Rock River on this major thoroughfare to access the Beloit Public Library and scenic riverfront parks.
cards.short_summary: A major east-west street connecting the college area to the west side and riverfront amenities.
cards.evidence_claim: Grand Avenue is a key downtown street mentioned in local guides and is home to the Grand Avenue Pub and other businesses.
cards.source_title: Getting Off Campus • Student Engagement & Leadership - Beloit College

cards.title: Pleasant Street
cards.subtitle: Riverside Corridor
cards.notes: Follow this street along the Rock River to reach the Visit Beloit center and the start of the Riverside Park trails.
cards.short_summary: A scenic street running parallel to the Rock River, housing the local tourism office.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Beloit is located at 656 Pleasant Street, serving as a hub for local information.
cards.source_title: Top 10 Things To Do For Beloit College Students

cards.title: Broad Street
cards.subtitle: Downtown Retail Block
cards.notes: Visit this block for unique local shops like Bushel & Peck's Local Market, offering farm-to-table goods and a cafe atmosphere.
cards.short_summary: A downtown street known for its local market and specialty retail shops.
cards.evidence_claim: Bushel & Peck's Local Market is a featured downtown destination for students.

cards.title: Public Avenue
cards.subtitle: Campus-Downtown Link
cards.notes: This street serves as a direct pedestrian link between the main campus and the downtown commercial district.
cards.short_summary: A transition street connecting the historic college grounds with the city center.
cards.evidence_claim: Public Avenue is shown on campus maps as a primary route leading toward downtown.

cards.title: Bushnell Street
cards.subtitle: Historic Residential Block
cards.notes: Walk past historic homes and the Bushnell Hall residence on this quiet street bordering the south side of campus.
cards.short_summary: A residential street featuring historic architecture and student housing.
cards.evidence_claim: Bushnell Hall is an all-female identifying residence hall located on Bushnell Street.
cards.source_title: Upper-level Student Housing • Residential Life - Beloit College

cards.title: College Street
cards.subtitle: Main Campus Thoroughfare
cards.notes: This street bisects the campus and is the location of 'The Wall,' the college's most famous informal meeting spot.
cards.short_summary: The central street running through the heart of the Beloit College campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Wall is located at the corner of College and Clary streets and is a primary campus landmark.
cards.source_title: The Best Spots on Campus • Admissions - Beloit College

cards.title: Prospect Street
cards.subtitle: Eastern Campus Border
cards.notes: This street marks the eastern edge of the main campus, providing access to several academic buildings and green spaces.
cards.short_summary: A north-south street defining the eastern boundary of the college grounds.
cards.evidence_claim: Prospect Street is a boundary street shown on the official Beloit College campus map.

cards.title: Park Avenue
cards.subtitle: Residential and Institutional Corridor
cards.notes: Travel north on this street to find local parks and residential neighborhoods popular for upperclassman off-campus living.
cards.short_summary: A long north-south avenue bordering the campus and extending into residential Beloit.
cards.evidence_claim: Park Avenue is a major street bordering the campus, as indicated on the college's flat map.

cards.title: Clary Street
cards.subtitle: Residential Housing Block
cards.notes: Home to the Clary Street Apartments, this block is a hub for upper-level student life and campus shuttles.
cards.short_summary: A street on the north side of campus primarily known for student apartment housing.
cards.evidence_claim: Clary Street Apartments provide co-ed upperclassmen housing on the edge of the residential side of campus.
cards.source_title: Upper-level Student Housing • Residential Life - Beloit College
cards.access_notes: Public residential street; shuttle stop located at the corner of College and Clary.
